mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portal_user_badge WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND achievement_id = #{achievementId}

SELECT b.id, b.achievement_id, a.code, a.name, a.description, a.icon, a.module, a.growth_reward, b.create_time FROM portal_user_badge b INNER JOIN portal_achievement a ON b.achievement_id = a.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY b.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO portal_user_badge (user_id, achievement_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{achievementId})
